action: opened the order: Invent one new widget that goes beyond everything in the catalog. One remarkable idea, or none.
Untapped capability: proposed Skimmed (skimmed-widget), Culprit (culprit-widget), Attic (attic-widget)
person at the terminal: proposed Last Green, Recall, Aftermath of a push (Verdict)
Delight: proposed Unsent (unsent-widget), Byline (byline-widget), Jar (jar-widget)
took the order at ideation
took the order at ideation

stamped reject on "Attic": Rejected twice before and nothing has changed: the engine already defers MCP tools, so the saving is a few cached built-in descriptions, bought with the risk that Claude does not reach for a tool it cannot see.

stamped reject on "Recall": The same widget as Deja vu, rejected twice: rare-word overlap on a half-typed prompt seldom fires on a real repeat and misfires on similar-looking ones, and an old answer rarely fits the new conversation.

stamped reject on "Unsent": Rejected before and nothing has changed: prompt.edit splices cannot reliably tell a swallowed sentence from ordinary editing, and the card puts on screen the words the person chose not to show.

stamped reject on "Jar": Rejected before as The jar and nothing has changed: a phrase counter with a picture beside badges-widget and the waiting mirror and wrapped widgets, built on a joke that is already everywhere.

stamped reject on "Culprit": It runs on the same two hooks as Amendments (WO-0028, on the floor), and the break it would name most days is the idle expiry that the waiting cache-widget already counts down; its best moment, an unstable plugin section, is too rare to carry a card.

stamped reject on "Verdict": A variation on tap-widget's clock-polled line and on gh run watch itself: GitHub only, needs a signed-in gh, and what it adds is a trigger on push, which is a feature rather than a new widget.

stamped reject on "Byline": A git blame line per edit beside the history, onthisday and theseus widgets: in a solo or Claude-written repository the answer is always you or Claude, so the moment it is built for almost never comes and the novelty wears off in a day.

stamped reject on "Skimmed": Not chosen: the most original idea here, but onScreen is absent outside the fullscreen layout, dwell must be guessed from edge-only reports while text streams past, and scroll lands on a whole message rather than the passage, so it would often accuse a reader wrongly; Last Green works in every layout and is exact.
named the widget green-widget ("Last Green")
named the widget skimmed-widget ("Skimmed")

stamped reject on "Last Green": Already on the floor: WO-0030 named green-widget for the same idea seconds before this order did, so here it is a duplicate; this order's earlier naming as green-widget and its not-chosen stamp on Skimmed are withdrawn.

stamped pass: Skimmed is the only idea left that is new and works with the API as it is: no widget reads onScreen, it is the first to watch what the person saw rather than what Claude did, it costs no tokens, and sharpened to claim only 'never on screen' and to quote the missed caveat on the card it states a fact instead of guessing at reading.
